description: Permissions granted to the Nox window. Deliberately minimal: core, the deep-link listener used to receive nox://auth-callback, and opening the Supabase OAuth consent URL in the real browser.

permissions.description: Open http/https links in the OS browser: the OAuth consent URL, and the web links the user saves in Resources — opening those in a real, sandboxed browser tab is the whole point of the module. Scheme-restricted to http/https so a saved value can never launch a file:// path or an arbitrary protocol handler.
